raw_message.reasoning:
So for unbalanced braces like `{hello`, the PARSE_RE.split doesn't produce any field parts - it just returns `['{hello']`. The `_generate_expression` method would then treat `{hello` as literal text, escaping special regex characters. The regex for `{hello` would become `\{hello` which would literally match `{hello` in the input string. This is the "incorrect partial matches" that R3 wants to prevent.

Now let me implement all three changes.
